name: Kolaiah
meaning: Benjamite of Jerusalem
notes: Kolaiah, a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.

name: Korah
meaning: Son of Hebron, descendant of Caleb
notes: Korah, son of Hebron, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Korah
meaning: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants
notes: Korah, a Levite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron; his descendants became temple musicians and gatekeepers.

name: Korah
meaning: Edomite chief, descendant of Eliphaz
notes: Korah, an Edomite chief, descendant of Eliphaz, son of Esau.

name: Korah
meaning: Son of Esau
notes: Korah, son of Esau and Oholibamah

name: Kore
meaning: Levite gatekeeper
notes: Kore, a Levite gatekeeper, descendant of Korah

name: Kore
meaning: Levite in charge of freewill offerings
notes: Kore, a Levite in charge of distributing freewill offerings during Hezekiah's reign.

name: Koz
meaning: Son of Ashhur, a Judahite
notes: Koz, a descendant of Judah through Ashhur.

name: Laadah
meaning: Son of Shelah, a Judahite
notes: Laadah, a son of Shelah and descendant of Judah.

name: Laban
meaning: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel
notes: Laban, the brother of Rebekah and father of Jacob's wives, Leah and Rachel.

name: Ladan
meaning: Descendant of Ephraim
notes: Ladan, a descendant of Ephraim.

name: Lael
meaning: Father of Eliasaph, a Gershonite Levite
notes: Lael, the father of Eliasaph, a leader of the Gershonite Levites.

name: Lahad
meaning: Son of Jahath, a Judahite
notes: Lahad, a descendant of Judah through Jahath.

name: Lahmi
meaning: Brother of Goliath the Gittite
notes: Lahmi, the brother of Goliath, was killed by Elhanan the Bethlehemite.

name: Laish
meaning: Father of Michal's husband Palti (or 'Paltiel')
notes: Laish, the father of Palti (or 'Paltiel'), to whom Saul gave his daughter Michal in marriage.

name: Lamech
meaning: Descendant of Cain; first polygamist mentioned in the Bible

name: Lamech
meaning: Father of Noah; lived 777 years
notes: Lamech, the father of Noah, lived 777 years.

name: Lappidoth
meaning: Husband of Deborah the prophetess and judge
notes: Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah, a prophetess and judge in Israel.

name: Lazarus
meaning: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

name: Lazarus
meaning: Poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man
notes: Lazarus, a poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man and Lazarus ( Luk.16.20-25 ).

name: Leah
meaning: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah
notes: Leah, the first wife of Jacob and mother of six of his sons and his daughter Dinah.

name: Lebanah

notes: Lebanah or Lebana, whose descendants were among the temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Lecah
meaning: Son of Er, a Judahite
notes: Lecah, a descendant of Judah through Er.

name: Lehabim
meaning: Son of Mizraim; progenitor of a people group
notes: Lehabim, a son of Mizraim and progenitor of a people group.

name: Lemuel
meaning: King mentioned in Proverbs; his mother taught him wisdom
notes: Lemuel, a king whose wise sayings are recorded in Proverbs 31, as taught by his mother.

name: Letushim

name: Leummim
meaning: Son of Dedan, descendant of Abraham and Keturah
notes: Leummim, a son of Dedan and descendant of Abraham and Keturah.

name: Levi

name: Levi
meaning: Son of Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus
notes: Levi, son of Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy ( Luk.3.24 ).
